chunks: It is narrated from one of them (peace be upon him) that he said:

When you intend to perform the Ziyarah of Abi al-Hasan the Third, Ali ibn Muhammad al-Jawad, and Abi Muhammad al-Hasan al-Askari (peace be upon them), you say after the Ghusl: if you reach their graves, [go to them]; otherwise, you gesture with the greeting from the door that is on the Shubbak street.

You say: Peace be upon you, O two Wali(s) of Allah. Peace be upon you, O two Hujjah(s) of Allah. Peace be upon you, O two lights of Allah in the darkness of the earth. Peace be upon you, O those about whom Allah manifested His matter. Peace be upon you, O two beloveds of Allah. Peace be upon you, O two Imams of guidance.

I have come to you acknowledging your right, opposing your enemies, befriending your friends, believing in what you believed in, disbelieving in what you disbelieved in, confirming what you confirmed, and invalidating what you invalidated.

I ask Allah, my Lord and your Lord, to make my portion from your Ziyarah the Salat upon Muhammad and his family, and to grant me companionship with you in the Gardens alongside your righteous fathers.

And I ask Him to free my neck from the Fire, to grant me your intercession and companionship, to introduce me to you, and not to deprive me of your love and the love of your righteous fathers, and not to make this the last covenant of my Ziyarah of you, and to resurrect me with you in Paradise by His mercy.
O Allah, grant me their love and cause me to die upon their religion. O Allah, curse those who oppressed the family of Muhammad regarding their right, and take revenge upon them.

O Allah, curse the first of them and the last, and multiply the punishment upon them. And convey to them, and to their followers, their followers, their lovers, and those who follow them, the lowest depth of Hell.
Verily You are Powerful over all things. O Allah, hasten the relief of Your Wali and the son of Your Wali, and make our relief with their relief, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
And strive in supplication for yourself and your parents, and choose from the supplications.
If you reach them (peace be upon them), then pray two Rak'ahs near their grave. And when you enter the mosque and pray, supplicate Allah with what you wish, for He is Near, Responsive.
And this mosque is next to the house, and in it they used to pray.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and procedure for visiting the graves of Imam al-Hadi and Imam al-Askari?
ai.summary: This narration from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* serves as a foundational text for the Shia practice of visiting the Imams in Samarra, emphasizing the theological concept of *al-Ghaybah al-Sughra* (Minor Occultation) where the Imams were accessible yet concealed. The supplication highlights key Shia doctrines including *al-Wilayah* (divine guardianship), *al-Muwalah wa al-Mu'adah* (loyalty to friends and enmity to foes), and the hope for *Shafa'ah* (intercession), linking the physical act of visitation to spiritual preparation for the ultimate return of the Twelfth Imam.
